title: Python Token Bucket Distributed Rate Limiter
description:
Implement a Token Bucket rate limiter in Python for distributed microservices.
This challenge demonstrates how unconfigured remote execution environments are safely and transparently surfaced to candidates without executing arbitrary code on the application server.
constraints: Refills tokens monotonically based on elapsed time.
sampleOutput: True for first 10 requests, False on 11th request until refill

testCases.name: Consumes tokens within capacity bound
testCases.explanation: Tokens are debited when capacity is available.

testCases.name: Rejects consumption when capacity is exceeded

hints: In production, containerized sandboxes (gVisor / Firecracker microVMs) execute non-JS languages with strict network and CPU limits.
Review the reference Python solution and compare against your architectural design.
